bullets: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1: seed the 'No items deferred.' sentinel in MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md when nothing is deferred, so Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 stops emitting a spurious WARN on every zero-deferral migration (the two scripts now agree on the empty-defer contract).

Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1: auto-add <AllowUnsafeBlocks>true</AllowUnsafeBlocks> to the scaffold csproj when copied source uses `unsafe`, preventing the CS0227 build round-trip on raw-buffer media samples (AudioGraph/custom effects/pixel access); MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md CS0227 note updated to reference the auto-fix.
